name: Adaptation
description: Your body adapts instantly to hostile or alien surroundings, letting you breathe, move, sense and survive there — growing gills and pressure resistance underwater, for instance. One flat purchase covers any environment; there are no ranks.

name: Alternate Form
description: You can turn into a different form, built as a separate character with its own Hero Point budget at the power level you pay for. Both forms must pay for this Power, and they share one Resolve pool — you use the lowest Resolve among them. Buy it again for each extra form.

power_cons.name: Independent Forms
power_cons.description: Each form has its own identity, memory and personality, and they need not get along.

notes: Cost scales with the alternate form's power level: 4/8/12/16/20/24 Hero Points for Street Level through Iconic.

name: Animal Control
description: You can make animals do what you want for the Power's duration, whether by domination or friendly persuasion. Roll against the animal's Willpower.

power_pros.name: Calling
power_pros.description: You can call to animals out to Extreme Range. They race to you, and the duration only starts once they arrive.

power_cons.name: Only X
power_cons.description: You can only control one category of animal, named at purchase. Worth more if the group is narrow or of limited use, such as aquatic animals.

name: Animal Empathy
description: You share an empathic understanding with animals. They will not attack you without good reason, and even then you may be able to talk them down.

power_pros.name: Speech
power_pros.description: You can talk with animals. How intelligent they are, and how they respond, is the GM's call.

name: Animal Mimicry
description: You can take on an animal's Powers, and its Agility, Might, Perception and Toughness, at the lower of the animal's rank or yours — and only where the animal's is higher than your own. Switching animals is a free action, once per page.

power_pros.name: Enhanced
power_pros.description: When mimicking an animal you may use your Power rank in place of its highest-ranked Trait — one Trait per animal.

power_pros.name: Selection
power_pros.description: You can mimic several animals at once and take the best Traits among them, but your effective rank drops by 1d per extra animal.

name: Animation
description: You can bring images and objects to life until the scene ends or you dismiss them. An animated thing has Agility, Might and Toughness plus whatever Powers suit it: one Trait at your full rank, the rest at half. They obey your mental commands. You cannot animate anything whose Structure beats your rank.

name: Armor
description: Armour or a personal force field that turns damage aside. Use it as a passive defence against both physical and energy attacks, and ignore any attack whose rank is at or below half your Armor rank unless it is Penetrating.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank is half your Toughness rank, rounded up.

power_cons.name: Activated
power_cons.description: The armour must be switched on — a free action — and it stops working if you are knocked out.

power_cons.name: Reactive
power_cons.description: Bracers, a shield or similar that you actively interpose, so it counts as an active defence rather than a passive one.

name: Astral Projection
description: Your astral form can leave your body, gaining Invisibility, Phasing and Astral Sight, and flying as though you had Flight at your Willpower rank. Your body lies dormant meanwhile, though you know at once if it is moved or harmed.

name: Attuned
description: You are attuned to an aspect of nature, a place, or the cosmos, and sense coming disturbances within it. Basic warnings arrive free; spend 1 Resolve to ask the GM for detail. What you learn may be incomplete, but it is never false.

name: Aura
description: Your body deals a chosen type of energy damage on contact — anyone touching or striking you in unarmed combat takes an attack at your Aura rank, resisted only by passive defences. You can also attack with it in close combat, and mundane objects weaker than your rank burn or melt near you.

power_cons.name: Spines
power_cons.description: Quills or spines inflicting physical rather than energy damage, which means the Power gives you no protection against physical attacks.

name: Banish
description: You can banish a target to another time, place or dimension, resisted by Willpower (or Toughness, if you define it that way) and by active defences. You cannot send anyone somewhere harmful or inescapable.

name: Blast
description: A damaging ranged attack. Name the type of damage it inflicts when you buy it.

power_pros.name: Block
power_pros.description: You can shoot incoming ranged attacks down, using the Power as an active defence against them — though not against area attacks.

power_pros.name: Melee
power_pros.description: You can use the Power as an active defence in close combat, which may change how it looks when you do.

power_cons.name: Subdual
power_cons.description: The Power inflicts subdual damage.

power_cons.name: Weapons
power_cons.description: The Power is mastery of a group of weapons, as broad or narrow as you like, and you must be armed with one to use it.

name: Blending
description: Your colouring shifts to match your surroundings, giving +3d on Covert rolls to avoid being seen. Stay still and you can roll Covert at half rank to go unnoticed even in the open.

name: Blind
description: You can blind a living target for the Power's duration, resisted by Toughness or an active defence. A blinded target takes -3d on attack and active defence rolls unless something like Blind Fighting or Radar covers for the loss.

name: Blind Fighting
description: You do not rely on sight in a fight, so darkness or an unseen opponent costs you nothing, whatever the cause.

name: Blink
description: You flicker in and out of reality mid-fight — phasing, shifting size, stepping through portals, however you describe it. Use Blink in place of Might for close combat attacks and in place of Agility for active defence and movement rolls. It does not actually make you faster.

name: Boost
description: You can raise one nominated Ability, Talent or Power up to this Power's rank. It costs as much per rank as the Trait it raises and uses that Trait as its baseline. It needs Cons describing when and how it works, or it means nothing.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals the rank of the Ability, Talent or Power nominated by the player when this Power is purchased.

power_cons.name: Rage
power_cons.description: The Power switches on when you lose your temper, but your Intellect and every Talent drop to 1d while the rage lasts. It always subsides by the end of a scene.

notes: Cost is Special: this Power costs as many Hero Points per rank as the Trait it raises, and uses that Trait as its baseline rank. The player must nominate the affected Trait; CostCalculator resolves the rate from it.

name: Buff
description: Spend 1 Resolve to bolster yourself and every ally in the area with +1d on all challenge rolls for the rest of the scene. Allies must stay in the area to keep it. Activating costs an action; sustaining it is free. Buff never stacks, not even from different Sources.

power_pros.name: Greater
power_pros.description: Spend extra Resolve to raise the bonus by +1d per point, up to +3d for 3 Resolve.

name: Clairvoyance
description: You can see distant places as though you stood there, at any distance. A shielded location calls for a Willpower roll against the shielding rank; another dimension needs a Superhuman (6) Willpower roll. You can focus on a familiar person or object instead, though that will not tell you where they are.

name: Cloud Minds
description: You cloud the minds of everyone within Distant Range, becoming undetectable to them by any sense. A target only gets a Willpower roll to shake it off if you close to Close Range or do something that gives you away. Costs an action each page to maintain.

name: Communications
description: You can detect, receive, store and transmit across whatever networks the setting has, worldwide or further, with no need for towers or satellites. It works by itself, though secure channels may call for a Technology roll.

name: Constructs
description: You can build and move shapes of solid force — cages, ramps, walls, hammers, nets and the like. They have Structure equal to your rank and exert force with an effective Might equal to it.

power_pros.name: Devices
power_pros.description: You can build complex machines and intricate shapes that imitate other Powers, working like a broad Omni-Power.

name: Danger Sense
description: You feel immediate physical danger coming, even from sources no sense could reach, such as a bomb beneath the floor. Use this Power instead of Perception both to notice danger and to work out your Edge, and you may make active defence rolls even when taken by surprise.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

name: Darkness
description: You fill the zone with darkness, fog, smoke or another obscuring element that only you and those equipped for it can see through. Anyone else takes -3d on attack and active defence rolls unless a Power compensates.

name: Dazzle
description: A blinding flash that overwhelms every living being in range, friend and foe alike, resisted by Willpower or an active defence. Targets are stunned for one page — unable to move or act — and then blinded for the rest of the duration.

power_cons.name: Deafen
power_cons.description: Targets are left deafened rather than blinded once the stun wears off — disorienting, and worth -1d on their rolls, but preferable to blindness.

name: Deflection
description: You can turn aside incoming ranged attacks of one chosen kind, physical or energy, using this rank as an active defence. When an attack fails to hurt you, spend a free action to send it back at the lower of its rank or yours. Area attacks cannot be deflected.

power_cons.name: Only X
power_cons.description: You can only deflect one specific type of object or energy, named at purchase.

name: Density
description: You can make yourself denser, substituting this rank for your Might and Toughness and gaining Armor at it too; where you already match or beat that, use your own rank +1d. You also get much heavier — at 3d or more your weight rank equals your Density rank.

name: Detection
description: You can sense and pinpoint something specific — a kind of energy, matter, creature, emotion or state. It usually works automatically, with a roll only for the faint or hidden, and unusually for a ranged Power it reaches Extreme Range.

power_pros.name: Long Range
power_pros.description: The Power reaches interplanetary distances — as far as the story needs, out to Plot Device Range.

name: Determination
description: Your determination is a byword even among Heroes. Every 5 Hero Points spent here gives you 1 extra Resolve at the start of each issue. It has no rank and cannot be absorbed, drained or mimicked. Heroes only.
notes: No rank. 5 Hero Points buys 1 extra starting Resolve per issue.

name: Dimensional Travel
description: You can travel to other dimensions, at the cost of an action. An unfamiliar dimension drops you somewhere random; after that you return where you left, or spend 1 Resolve to arrive somewhere familiar. Free uses per issue equal your Willpower, then 1 Resolve each.

power_pros.name: Portal
power_pros.description: You can open portals others can travel through.

name: Dispel
description: You can end any ongoing Power affecting a being or object, resisted by that Power's rank. It does not stop the Power working again — it only cuts the current duration short. Limited to one Source, chosen at purchase. Also usable as an active defence against special effects.

power_pros.name: Also X
power_pros.description: You can dispel Powers from more than one Source. Each extra Source adds 1 Hero Point per 2 ranks.

name: Drain
description: You can drain Abilities, Talents and Powers of one chosen Source, rolling against the target's highest-ranked Trait of that Source. Drained Abilities and Talents fall to 1d and drained Powers stop entirely for the duration. Traits of other Sources are untouched and cannot resist.

power_pros.name: Also X
power_pros.description: You can affect Traits from more than one Source. Each extra Source adds 1 Hero Point per 2 ranks.

power_cons.name: Only X
power_cons.description: You can only affect one kind of Trait — Abilities, Talents or Powers. Worth more if it is one specific Ability, Talent or Power.

name: Duplication
description: Spend an action to create an exact duplicate of yourself, minus this Power. Duplicates share your limited-use Powers and have no Resolve of their own, though you may spend yours for them. A duplicate vanishes when either of you is defeated, and cannot return that scene.

name: Elemental Control
description: You create and control one element — fire, ice, gravity, sound, plants, whatever you choose — and through it imitate other Powers at this rank, so long as the effect makes comic-book sense for your element.

power_pros.name: Matter Creation
power_pros.description: Matter you create is normally unstable and gone by the end of the scene; this lets you make it permanent.

power_cons.name: Only Control
power_cons.description: You can control your element but not create it, so you depend on whatever is already in range.

name: Emotion Control
description: You can flood anyone in range with an overwhelming feeling: rage, fear, love, confusion, despair. Resisted by Willpower. The GM decides how the target acts, and the reaction is often powerful and irrational.

power_cons.name: Only X
power_cons.description: You can only produce one emotion or mental state, named at purchase.

power_cons.name: Pheromones
power_cons.description: The Power is chemical. Targets resist with the greater of Toughness or Willpower, and anything that does not breathe — or is sealed against the air — is immune.

name: Energy Absorption
description: You can absorb one type of energy, siphoned from a source or taken from an attack, up to the lesser of its rank and yours. You are immune to energy attacks at or below your rank and can use this as a passive defence above it. Absorbed energy must be spent at once — boosting a physical Ability, granting +1d to all rolls, firing out as a Blast, or healing damage.

power_pros.name: Also X
power_pros.description: Absorb one extra type of energy per purchase. It cannot be used to add kinetic energy after the fact.

notes: Variable per-rank cost: 1 Hero Point per rank normally, 3 if you can absorb kinetic energy (subject to GM approval).

name: Ensnare
description: You can bind a target in ice, webbing, vines or the like so they cannot take physical actions, resisted by Might, an active defence, or Aura used as a passive defence.

power_pros.name: Line
power_pros.description: A line or tether that also lets you reel an ensnared target in, provided their weight rank does not exceed your rank.

power_cons.name: Immobilize
power_cons.description: You only pin targets in place. They cannot move, but they can still take any other physical action.

name: Evasion
description: You are never standing still. Use Evasion in place of Agility for active defence rolls, movement rolls, and combat stunts. It does not actually make you faster.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Agility rank.

name: Expertise
description: A specialisation — an area of knowledge, proficiency or skill that sits under one of your Abilities or Talents, named when you buy it. Use this Power's rank in place of that Trait whenever the specialisation applies. Its baseline rank is that Trait's rank.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals the rank of the Ability, Talent or Power nominated by the player when this Power is purchased.

notes: Baseline rank equals the rank of the Ability or Talent the specialisation falls under, nominated by the player at purchase.

name: Extra Limbs
description: Extra arms, tentacles, a prehensile tail or similar, worth +2d on attack and defence rolls when grappling. The GM may extend that to anything else more limbs would plainly help, like climbing.

name: Flight
description: A Travel Power: you can fly. Flight needs room to manoeuvre, so halve your effective rank indoors unless the space is unusually large.

power_pros.name: Spaceflight
power_pros.description: You can exceed light speed in open space, crossing interstellar distances — assuming you can survive out there.

power_cons.name: Gliding
power_cons.description: You glide rather than fly, losing at least a storey each page unless you find a rising current.

power_cons.name: Levitation
power_cons.description: You can only rise, descend and hover.

power_cons.name: Slides
power_cons.description: You surf on matter or energy you lay down as you go, so you must stay within Distant Range of the ground or other large solid objects.

power_cons.name: Wings
power_cons.description: Wings need room, so you cannot fly in cramped spaces, thin atmosphere or vacuum.

name: Force Field
description: A projected field that shields everyone inside it. Protected characters use your rank as a passive defence against physical and energy attacks, and are immune to any attack at or below half your rank.

power_pros.name: Inviolate
power_pros.description: Spend 1 Resolve when raising the field and it repels Power effects of equal or lower rank as well as direct attacks.

power_pros.name: Permeable
power_pros.description: You can let attacks pass out through the field in one direction, so you and your allies can attack from inside it.

power_cons.name: Collapsible
power_cons.description: The field collapses when hit by an attack above your rank. It still defends against that attack, but restoring it costs an action.

power_cons.name: Ward
power_cons.description: The field stops mental attacks rather than physical ones. It is the only kind that can hold someone using Phasing (Intangible).

name: Form — Energy
description: You can become one type of energy, gaining Aura and Flight at this rank. You are weightless and immune to physical and energy attacks, but you can carry and touch nothing, objects and force fields can still contain you, and whatever affects your energy affects you.

power_pros.name: Also X
power_pros.description: One extra type of energy you can become, per purchase.

name: Form — Gaseous
description: You can become a gas with 1d Flight — weightless, immune to physical and energy attacks, and able to slip through any opening a gas could. You can touch nothing physical, and you become vulnerable to what affects gases.

name: Form — Liquid
description: You can become a liquid or a mass of fine particles, immune to physical but not energy attacks, and able to flow through any gap a liquid could. You can still solidify enough to handle things and attack. Your body remains physical, so it can be contained or shoved.

name: Form — Solid
description: You can become solid matter — ice, metal, stone, wood. Substitute this rank for your Might and Toughness and gain Armor at it; where you already match or beat that, use your own rank +1d.

name: Gestalt
description: Requires the Alter Ego Flaw. Your powered form is two people merged, each alter ego a separate character with their own Abilities, Talents and possibly Powers. Further alter egos cost 3 Hero Points each.

name: Growth
description: You can grow enormous. From 4d your weight rank equals your Growth rank. Substitute this rank for your Might and Toughness, gain Armor at it, and gain Running at half it for the length of your stride; where you already match or beat those, use your own rank +1d.

name: Hard to Kill
description: You are hard to kill — it would take something extreme, like beheading or a volcano. Characters with this Power know it about themselves and can be played accordingly.

name: Healing
description: You can heal anyone you touch. Your rank is the maximum damage you can heal per day. The GM may let it cure disease on a successful roll, or for Resolve.

power_cons.name: Repair
power_cons.description: Your touch mends inanimate things rather than living ones — androids, machines, robots, vehicles and most technology.

name: Hibernation
description: You can enter suspended animation for as long as you like, barely ageing and needing no air, food or drink. You stay aware of your surroundings and can wake yourself at will.

name: Hyper Breath
description: You can exhale gale-force wind to push or pull, rolling against the greater of each target's Might or weight rank. One or two net successes move them to you or out to Distant Range; three or more also knock them prone and cost them their next turn. Hits everyone in Close Range, or one target further out.

power_pros.name: Freezing
power_pros.description: Your breath can also freeze, imitating Blast (cold) or Ensnare, but only within Close Range.

name: Illusions
description: You can create illusions of any size up to the whole area, with sight and sound. They exist in the world and register on cameras and microphones. Observers accept them until given reason to doubt, then may roll Perception against your rank to see through them.

power_pros.name: Mental
power_pros.description: The illusions form in the minds of living beings, so a doubting observer resists with Willpower rather than Perception.

name: Immortality
description: You cannot die, or cannot stay dead, and you will not die of age. In a game where Heroes can die, GMs should charge more for this — somewhere between 6 and 12 Hero Points.

power_cons.name: Vulnerable
power_cons.description: You can be killed, though not easily. Describe how.

name: Immunity
description: You are immune to specific attacks, energies, conditions, hazards or Powers. Each immunity is named and paid for separately.
notes: Cost is 3 Hero Points per immunity selected.

name: Inanimate
description: You are not alive in the ordinary sense — a construct, a robot, undead, something stranger. You are immune to physical attacks and to Powers that only touch the living, helpful ones included, and you effectively have Immunity (Life Support, Toxins). Your mind or spirit is still open to mental Powers. No rank, and it cannot be absorbed, drained or mimicked.

power_pros.name: Mindless
power_pros.description: You have neither mind nor spirit — a true robot, or an animated skeleton — so mental attacks and Powers cannot touch you either.

name: Invisibility
description: You can turn invisible. Other senses, Powers like Radar and Super Senses, and traces you leave in the world can still find you. Enemies who cannot see you take -3d on attack and active defence rolls against you, or -2d if they can detect you some other way.

power_pros.name: Cloaking
power_pros.description: Turning invisible also hides you from Radar, every vision-based Super Sense, and sensors and equipment that would otherwise pick you up.

power_cons.name: Jamming
power_cons.description: You cannot turn invisible, but you can make yourself undetectable to Radar, vision-based Super Senses and equivalent sensors.

name: Irritant
description: You fill the area around you with something wretched — stinging sand, howling wind, gas, a swarm of insects. Everyone but you takes -2d on all challenge rolls except passive defences unless their Toughness (or Willpower, if you define it so) beats your rank. Activating costs an action; sustaining it is free.

name: Languages
description: You speak a number of extra languages equal to your Intellect, chosen in advance or on the spot.

power_pros.name: Hyper Translation
power_pros.description: You are instantly fluent in any language you meet, barring ones your voice cannot produce or your senses cannot perceive.

power_pros.name: Polyglot
power_pros.description: Languages come naturally. You can get by in a new one within a day or two and master it in about a week.

name: Leadership
description: You lead your team in battle. While you can see and speak to them, spend a free action to let each ally reroll one challenge roll per combat scene.

name: Leaping
description: A Travel Power: you jump enormous distances. Subtract 1d from your rank to find how high you can jump straight up. Its baseline is half your Might.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank is half your Might rank, rounded up.

name: Life Drain
description: You drain the life from a living being you touch, resisted by Toughness (or Willpower, if you define it so) and by active defences, inflicting 1 damage per net success. If you are wounded, you heal 1 point for every 2 you inflict.

power_pros.name: Vampirism
power_pros.description: The Power inflicts real physical damage rather than draining life energy, so targets resist it as they would any physical attack.

name: Light / Effect
description: You generate light — visible, or ultraviolet if you prefer — effortlessly, always as a free action. It can fill your zone or focus into a beam or harmless laser out to Distant Range, at any brightness short of incapacitating. Blinding people outright is Dazzle.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: Your reflexes are extraordinary: your Edge goes up by 6. You can also draw or stow any weapon instantly, which under the Gritty Combat Rules makes it impossible for anyone to get the drop on you.

power_cons.name: Fighting/Marksmanship
power_cons.description: The Power applies only to close combat or only to ranged combat, and you can only quick-draw that type of weapon.

name: Luck
description: You are absurdly lucky, or so skilled it looks that way. Each issue you gain Luck dice equal to your rank, addable to either side of any challenge roll involving you — spend them to boost your own roll, or to roll against someone acting on you and subtract your successes from theirs.

power_pros.name: Control
power_pros.description: You bend probability deliberately rather than merely being lucky, letting you use Luck on yourself or anyone within Distant Range.

power_pros.name: Unbelievable
power_pros.description: You can also spend Luck dice on lucky breaks, and they tend to be more extreme than ones bought with Resolve.

name: Machine Control
description: You can control machines and electronics out to Distant Range — hacking a computer, killing a camera, driving a car from afar. Substitute this rank for whatever Trait operating the machine would normally need. Controlling several at once costs effectiveness.

power_cons.name: Interface
power_cons.description: You can only control computers — which still covers any machine a computer controls.

name: Martial Arts
description: You are a master of unarmed combat, using this Power to make and defend against close combat attacks. Substitute it for Might on grabs, holds, escapes and combat stunts, and for your Ability ranks when fighting with mundane melee weapons.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Might rank.

power_pros.name: Deflect
power_pros.description: Use Martial Arts as an active defence against ranged physical and energy attacks, though not area attacks.

power_pros.name: Deflect Missiles
power_pros.description: Use Martial Arts as an active defence against ranged physical attacks, though not area attacks.

name: Master of Disguise
description: You can build convincing disguises inside a short scene given basic materials, and you mimic voice and manner expertly. Roll Charm, usually against the target's Perception.

name: Matter Chameleon
description: You take on the properties of objects you touch for the rest of the scene. It works like Solid Form at the lesser of your rank or the object's Structure, and you also pick up its energetic properties as Aura — the heat of lava, for instance — at the lesser of your rank or that energy's.

name: Mind Blast
description: A mental attack on the mind or spirit that inflicts psychic damage on living beings, resisted by Willpower. It does nothing to inanimate objects and passes straight through them unless they have a psychic presence.

name: Mind Control
description: You can make any living being within Distant Range obey you for the duration, resisted by Willpower. Command them now, or spend 1 Resolve to plant a suggestion to trigger later, even months on. Targets get +2d to resist orders that are wholly against their nature.

power_cons.name: Hypnosis
power_cons.description: You need a calm face-to-face conversation with the target first, which makes it useless in combat.

power_cons.name: Pheromones
power_cons.description: The Power is chemical. Targets resist with the greater of Toughness or Willpower, and anything that does not breathe is immune.

name: Nullify
description: A dampening field that shuts down the Abilities, Talents and Powers of everyone in range, friend and foe alike. Nullified Abilities and Talents drop to 1d, nullified Powers stop entirely. It works automatically on any Trait at or below your rank, no roll needed, but only against one chosen Source, and you must concentrate to hold it.

power_pros.name: Also X
power_pros.description: You can nullify Traits from more than one Source. Each extra Source adds 1 Hero Point per rank.

name: Omni-Power
description: A versatile ability that mimics other Powers at this rank. You can switch between them instantly and use as many per page as you like, but every use after the first on the same page drops your effective rank by 1d for the rest of that page. A narrow Omni-Power costs less per rank than a broad one.
notes: Variable per-rank cost: narrow Omni-Powers cost 3 Hero Points per rank, broad ones 5. Cannot mimic Alternate Form, Determination, Inanimate, Life Drain, Luck, Nullify, Power Absorption, Power Mimicry, Preparation, Slay or Time Stop.

name: Phasing
description: You can shift out of phase with the physical world — immune to physical and energy attacks though not mental ones, and able to pass through solid matter but not force fields. You can touch nothing physical while phased. Switching on or off is a free action, but not both in the same turn.

power_pros.name: Intangible
power_pros.description: Ordinary force fields cannot hold you. Ones with the Ward Con still can, unless your Willpower beats their rank.

name: Plasticity
description: Your body is rubbery and elastic, so you can mould yourself into shapes and squeeze through the narrowest gaps. Shape yourself to imitate effects at this rank — a ball to Leap, a coil to hold something in place instead of using Might, a canopy to serve as a parachute.

name: Polymorph
description: You can turn a living being into something harmless or helpless — a frog, a statue — resisted by Toughness (or Willpower, if you define it so) and by active defences. The change lasts for the duration.

name: Portable Storehouse
description: You can reach a store of mundane weapons, armour, gear and even vehicles from anywhere — teleported in, pulled from a bag, conjured, however you describe it. What you draw lasts until the scene ends unless you have Resources or Wealth.

name: Possession
description: You can take over a living body within Distant Range, resisted by Willpower. You use the host's physical Traits and your own mental ones. Your body lies dormant, though you know at once if it is moved or harmed, and you snap back to it if the host is defeated.

power_pros.name: Meld
power_pros.description: Your body merges into the one you possess for the duration.

name: Power Absorption
description: You can steal a character's Abilities, Talents and Powers of one chosen Source by touch, rolling against their highest-ranked Trait of that Source or an active defence. Success knocks them out and you hold the stolen Traits at their rank for the duration. Traits you already have at equal or higher rank are unaffected.

power_pros.name: Also X
power_pros.description: You can absorb Traits from more than one Source. Each extra Source adds 1 Hero Point per rank.

power_cons.name: Only X
power_cons.description: You can only absorb one kind of Trait — Abilities, Talents or Powers. Worth more if it is one specific Trait.

name: Precognition
description: You can rewrite what has just happened — through foresight, prediction, or actually winding time back. Spend Resolve to cancel an event; in combat that erases a character's turn and moves you straight to your next turn ahead of them. Declare it the moment their turn ends.

name: Power Mimicry
description: You can copy a character's Abilities, Talents and Powers of one chosen Source by touch, rolling against their highest-ranked Trait of that Source or an active defence. You gain them at their rank for the duration and the target loses nothing. Traits you already have at equal or higher rank are unaffected.

power_pros.name: Also X
power_pros.description: You can mimic Traits from more than one Source. Each extra Source adds 1 Hero Point per rank.

power_cons.name: Only X
power_cons.description: You can only mimic one kind of Trait — Abilities, Talents or Powers. Worth more if it is one specific Trait.

name: Preparation
description: Your meticulous research and planning make your narrations far more effective when your preparation explains them — declaring that you brought exactly the right tool, that you memorised the layout, that you planned for this.

name: Psi-Screen
description: Your mental and spiritual defences are honed. Use this instead of Willpower against mental attacks and to resist mental damage and effects. You also know when someone tries to read your surface thoughts, and can use this Power to stop them probing your mind.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Willpower rank.

power_pros.name: Cloak Mind
power_pros.description: You can hide your mental presence. A telepath must beat your Psi-Screen rank to detect you at all.

name: Psychometry
description: By touching an inanimate object you read impressions from it and may ask the GM its basic history. Spend 1 Resolve for depth about a person or event connected to it. What you learn may be incomplete or misleading, but it is always truthful and always on point.

name: Quick Change
description: You can change clothes and grooming in an instant. Describe how. Using it takes an action.

power_cons.name: Costume
power_cons.description: You can only switch between your costume and whatever you were wearing when you last changed.

name: Radar
description: A radar sense giving you a three-dimensional picture of your surroundings. It cannot read flat images — print, photographs, screens.

power_cons.name: Sonar
power_cons.description: The Power only works underwater.

power_cons.name: Tremor Sense
power_cons.description: You read vibrations in the ground instead, so you only detect things touching the ground or shaking it.

name: Regeneration
description: You heal 1 point of damage per hour. Knocked unconscious, you wake as soon as you heal a point, unless revived sooner.

power_pros.name: Fast
power_pros.description: You heal 1 point of damage per minute rather than per hour.

power_pros.name: Instant
power_pros.description: You heal 1 point of damage per page rather than per hour.

name: Resistance
description: You shrug off radiation, temperature extremes and toxins — disease, drugs and poison. Use this instead of Toughness to resist such hazards.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Toughness rank.

name: Running
description: A Travel Power: you run faster than any human, or roll, skate or bounce if you prefer. Its 3d baseline is ordinary human running speed, so purchased ranks are what make you fast.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank is a flat 3d regardless of any Ability.

power_pros.name: Hover
power_pros.description: You float a foot off the ground while moving, ignoring caltrops, pressure plates, tripwires, broken ground and the like.

name: Separation
description: You can detach parts of your body without bleeding or screaming. Detached parts act independently and can do whatever a healthy detached part reasonably could, taking your other Powers into account.

name: Shockwave
description: A concussive wave striking everyone in range, friend and foe alike, rolled against the greater of each target's Might or weight rank. One or two net successes push them back with -1d on all rolls until after your next turn; three or more knock them further and harder.

name: Shrinking
description: You can shrink, dropping your weight rank by your current Shrinking rank until it reaches 0d. Substitute this rank for your Agility, and gain Leaping and Strike at half it; where you already match or beat those, use your own rank +1d. Being small also changes how easily you are hit.

name: Slay
description: You can wound a living target you touch, resisted by Toughness (or Willpower, if you define it so) and by active defences, inflicting 2 damage per net success. Armor does not protect against it at all.

name: Slick
description: You can make any part of the ground in range slippery for the rest of the scene or until you dismiss it. Crossing it calls for an Agility roll against your rank or the character falls prone; standing again costs an action and another roll.

name: Speak with Dead
description: You can briefly animate the dead to talk to them, asking a number of questions equal to your rank, which must be answered truthfully. The dead know only what they knew alive and speak only languages they knew. You need a body, or at least a head.

name: Specialty
description: Free, and only in Street Level and Low Level games. It gives each Hero one thing they alone excel at, so otherwise-similar characters stay distinct. One Specialty per Hero, and no two Heroes may share one.
notes: Free, and restricted to Street Level and Low Level games. Each Hero may have only one, and no two Heroes may share one.

name: Spinning
description: You can spin on your axis at superhuman speed. Use Spinning in place of Might for close combat attacks and defence, grabs, holds, escapes and combat stunts, and in place of Agility where spinning would serve.

name: Star Gate
description: You can transport yourself instantly to distant worlds, at the cost of an action. An unfamiliar world drops you somewhere random; after that you return where you left, or spend 1 Resolve for a familiar destination. Free uses per issue equal your Willpower, then 1 Resolve each.

power_pros.name: Portal
power_pros.description: You can open portals others — ships included — can travel through.

name: Stretching
description: You can stretch or extend your body, making close combat and grappling attacks against targets who are not adjacent. The reach you pay for sets the range: Close, Distant or Extreme.

power_cons.name: Long Reach
power_cons.description: You have long reach but cannot stretch your whole body.

notes: Variable flat cost by reach: 1 Hero Point for Close Range, 3 for Distant Range, 6 for Extreme Range.

name: Strike
description: A damaging close combat attack — claws, energised fists, a signature melee weapon — used both to attack and to defend in close combat. Name the damage type when you buy it. Its baseline is the greater of your Might and your Martial Arts.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank is the greater of your Might and your Martial Arts effective rank. Under the Brute Option, only half your Might counts.

power_pros.name: Deflect
power_pros.description: Use Strike as an active defence against ranged physical and energy attacks, though not area attacks.

power_pros.name: Deflect Missiles
power_pros.description: Use Strike as an active defence against ranged physical attacks, though not area attacks.

power_pros.name: Reach/Throw
power_pros.description: You can hit targets within Close Range who are not adjacent, either through unusual reach or by throwing whatever you strike with.

power_pros.name: Sweep
power_pros.description: The Power becomes an area attack covering a 90-degree arc within 5 to 25 feet — friend and foe alike, as area attacks always are.

power_cons.name: Subdual
power_cons.description: The Power inflicts subdual damage.

power_cons.name: Weapons
power_cons.description: The Power is mastery of a group of weapons, as broad or narrow as you like, and you must be armed with one to use it.

notes: Baseline rank is Might or Martial Arts, whichever is greater. Under the Brute Option (Overkill applied to Might) only half your Might counts toward this baseline.

name: Stun
description: You can take a living opponent out of the action — stunned, paralysed, asleep, disabled, however you describe it — resisted by Toughness (or Willpower, if you define it so) and by active defences.

power_cons.name: EMP
power_cons.description: The Power affects characters with Inanimate from a Tech Source instead of living beings, and disables most electronics.

name: Summoning
description: You can call Minions to serve you, your rank setting how many per scene. You fix their Threat rank at purchase, up to the Trait Cap −6d, or −3d if you summon no more than ten per scene. The cost per rank rises with the Threat you give them.

power_pros.name: Animals
power_pros.description: Your Minions are animals with the advantages that implies — keen senses, speed. Worth more for a wide variety than a narrow selection.

power_pros.name: Automatons
power_pros.description: Your Minions have the Inanimate (Mindless) Power.

power_pros.name: Duplicates
power_pros.description: Your Minions are copies of you. They fight as Minions using their Threat, but share your distinctive abilities.

power_pros.name: Shooters
power_pros.description: Your Minions can attack at Distant Range as well as in close combat.

power_pros.name: Unique
power_pros.description: Your Minions have abilities that would be Powers on a real character — acute senses, flight, walking through walls. Priced by how big an advantage it is.

notes: Cost is Special: 1 Hero Point per rank for every 2d of Threat given to the Minions (rounded up). Threat rank is chosen at purchase, capped at Trait Cap - 6d, or Trait Cap - 3d if you summon no more than 10 Minions per scene.

name: Super Senses — Acute (X)
description: One sense is hyper-acute, chosen at purchase. Substitute this rank for your Perception on challenge rolls involving that sense — but not when working out your Edge.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Analytic (X)
description: You can use one chosen sense to read the basic physical properties of whatever you concentrate on, including chemical make-up and whether it is organic.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Astral Sight
description: You can see into the astral realm, letting you deal with invisible spirits and astral projectors, and spot living beings hidden by Powers like Blending or Invisibility.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Circular Vision
description: You effectively have a 360-degree field of view.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Enhanced Hearing
description: You can catch sounds too faint, distant or muffled for ordinary ears with a Perception roll at a GM-set threshold of 4 or higher, and you hear infrasound and ultrasound.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Hypersensitive Touch
description: Your touch is fine enough to read print with your fingertips, or to work out what is happening in the next room from the vibrations through a wall.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Lie Detection
description: You can tell when someone within Close Range is lying. Automatic, unless they are shielded from it, which calls for a Perception roll.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Microscopic Vision
description: Concentrating, you can see microscopic detail — down to atomic or quantum scale if the story asks for it.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Night Vision
description: You can see in absolute darkness.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Radio Hearing
description: You can hear radio frequencies and intercept radio transmissions.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Telescopic Vision
description: You can pick out small details at extreme distance, as far as the story needs.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Thermal Vision
description: You see heat, letting you look through thin objects and follow faint residual warmth. It also serves in the dark, though extreme ambient temperatures or perfectly matched body heat can defeat it.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Tracking Scent
description: You can identify, recognise and track people by scent, and even read their mood. These call for Perception rolls at thresholds of 4 to 6 in good conditions.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — True Sight
description: Concentrating, you see a being's true form through disguise, illusion and transformation of any kind, Blending and Invisibility included. Automatic unless the subject is shielded, which calls for a Perception roll.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — Ultra Vision
description: You see ultraviolet light, and you have low-light vision down to starlight — though not in total darkness.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Senses — X-Ray Vision
description: Concentrating, you can see through solid objects.

prerequisite.description: Baseline rank equals your Perception rank.

notes: The rulebook treats all Super Senses options as a single Power whose effective rank is the greater of your Perception and your Acute rank. Each option is bought and paid for separately.

name: Super Speed
description: You move at superhuman speed. You run at Power rank speed, your Agility effectively equals this rank, and your Edge equals this rank times 3. Use it to attack and defend in close combat, and in place of Might when defending a grapple. At 9d or more you cross two range classes a page, run over water and up walls, and effectively gain Quick Change and Vanish.

name: Swimming
description: A Travel Power: you move through water at speed, breathe it, move and sense as freely below as above, and shrug off oceanic pressure and temperature.

power_cons.name: Lungs
power_cons.description: You cannot breathe water, though you can hold your breath a long time.

name: Swing Line
description: A Travel Power: you ascend, descend and swing from place to place. It needs outdoors or a large indoor space, and anchors — buildings or tall trees — within Distant Range. Your lines have Structure equal to half your rank.

power_cons.name: Natural
power_cons.description: You cannot make your own lines, so the Power only works where nature provides them — jungle vines and the like.

name: Telekinesis
description: You can move objects out to Distant Range with your mind, using this rank as your effective Might, to attack, immobilise, lift or throw. It also serves as an active defence against ranged attacks: physical ones directly, energy ones only by interposing an object.

power_cons.name: Impel
power_cons.description: You can shove objects in a straight line or hold them still, but fine manipulation is beyond you.

name: Telepathy
description: You can read minds and send thoughts within Distant Range. You sense the sentient minds around you, though other telepaths may cloak themselves. Reading surface thoughts is rolled against the higher of the target's Willpower or Telepathy, and telepaths feel it happen. You can also probe memories.

power_pros.name: Alter Memories
power_pros.description: Three or more net successes on a mind probe let you rewrite the subject's memories. The change lasts the scene.

power_pros.name: Cloak Others
power_pros.description: You can hide the mental presence of everyone within Close Range of you, not just your own.

power_pros.name: Dream Travel
power_pros.description: You can enter and take part in the dreams of others. Inside a dream your physical Traits become the greater of your Willpower or Telepathy.

power_pros.name: Mind Link
power_pros.description: You can link minds up to your Power rank so all of them can talk to each other. They must stay within Extreme Range of you.

power_cons.name: Empathy
power_cons.description: You are limited to sensing and sending emotions and moods — never words or images.

name: Teleportation
description: You can travel instantly, through solid objects but not force fields. Places you can see or know well give no trouble. Teleporting somewhere unfamiliar means rolling two dice: 6 or less and you nearly materialise inside something solid, so the Power fails, you snap back, and the shock knocks you out.

power_pros.name: Portal
power_pros.description: You can open portals others can travel through.

power_cons.name: Medium
power_cons.description: You can only travel along or through some medium — power lines, shadows, reflective surfaces.

name: Time Stop
description: You can freeze time in the area for a number of pages equal to your rank, or until you release it. The first use in a scene costs 1 Resolve, the second 2, and so on. Everything in the area is stuck; you can move about and move objects and people around freely.

name: Time Travel
description: You can travel through time in either direction, at the cost of an action. Talk to your GM first — they decide how time travel works in the setting and may set conditions.

power_pros.name: Portal
power_pros.description: You can open portals others can travel through.

name: Total Recall
description: You remember anything you paid attention to, automatically, and can roll Intellect against a GM threshold to recall background detail you never consciously noted.

power_pros.name: Playback
power_pros.description: Common among cyborgs and robots: your memories can be transferred, stored, copied and shown to others.

name: Tracer
description: You can tag objects you touch and follow them anywhere in the world for the rest of the story. Automatic, unless the object reaches somewhere that blocks the Power, which calls for an Intellect roll. Anyone suspecting a tracer needs a Daunting (3) Perception roll to find it.

power_pros.name: Tracking
power_pros.description: An object the subject recently owned, or a place they visited in the last day or so, lets you track them as though you had tagged them.

name: Transformation — Animal Forms
description: You can turn into animals, taking their look, form, size and weight, and gaining their Agility, Might, Perception, Toughness and Powers at the lesser of their rank or yours. Any natural animal you know, living or extinct; magical creatures are the GM's call.

power_pros.name: Enhanced
power_pros.description: When you take an animal's shape you may use your Power rank in place of its highest-ranked Trait — one Trait per animal.

power_cons.name: Only X
power_cons.description: You can only become one category of animal, named at purchase. Worth more if it is a single animal or a very limited group.

name: Transformation — Doppelganger
description: You can become an exact duplicate of anyone you have seen, so long as they are roughly humanoid and near your size. You will fool biometrics and even DNA analysis, but you gain none of their Abilities, Talents or Powers.

name: Transformation — Object Forms
description: You can turn into objects, from simple shapes to tools, weapons, machines and vehicles. As a shape you exert force or resistance at your rank; as a tool or weapon you add half your rank to the rolls of whoever wields you; as a machine or vehicle you gain its capabilities.

name: Transformation — Shapeshifting
description: You can reshape your body at will. You have Hero Points equal to your rank to spend temporarily on raising Agility, Might and Toughness and on buying Powers representing claws, wings, gills, hide and the like. Nothing may exceed the game's Trait Cap.

name: Transmutation
description: You can alter the chemical make-up of inanimate matter you touch, and gas within Close Range automatically. Liquids and solids are rolled against the greater of their Structure or weight rank. You can raise Structure up to your rank or lower it freely, turning solids to liquids or gases and back.

power_cons.name: Fighting/Marksmanship
power_cons.description: The Power applies only in close combat or only at range, and its bonus to mundane weapons is limited to that kind.

name: Vanish
description: You vanish from sight in an instant and move as far as you can in one page without anyone seeing where you went, often behind a flash or a puff of smoke. It costs both an action and your movement.

name: Tunneling
description: A Travel Power: you travel by digging through the ground. Collapse the tunnel behind you or leave it open for others. Nothing shows above ground, which makes it an excellent way to surprise people.

name: Two-Dimensional
description: You can become two-dimensional, like a shadow, weightless and silent, while still affecting and being affected by the three-dimensional world. You can slide along any surface ignoring gravity, and slip through any crack wide enough for your form.

name: Two-Fisted
description: You fight with both hands. Spend 1 Resolve to defeat twice the usual Minions — 2 per net success — on a physical attack, and you may decide after rolling. It adds nothing to attacks that already work that way. Dual-wielding mundane weapons also raises their Weapon Bonus by +1d.

name: Variant
description: A different version of a Power you already have. It costs a flat 3 Hero Points but must be worth as many Hero Points as the original, so the difference has to be made up with Cons.
notes: Costs a flat 3 Hero Points but must be worth as many Hero Points as the Power it varies — the difference has to be made up with Cons. Cannot vary Alternate Form and several other Powers.

name: Ventriloquism
description: You are a master of mimicry and ventriloquism, able to imitate almost any sound or voice and throw it so it seems to come from elsewhere. Roll Charm, usually against the target's Perception.

name: Wall-Crawling
description: You can stick to walls and ceilings and move along them at your normal speed. If this rank is lower than your Might, it limits how much you can carry while crawling. Unusually slick surfaces may call for a roll.

name: Weakness Detection
description: You can find the weak point of any person or object you observe in person. Spend 1 Resolve and your physical and energy attacks gain the Penetrating Pro against that target for the rest of the scene. It also tells you, free, about an object's structural flaws and stress points.
